name: American Wire Group
old_description: AWG specializes in providing wire and cable solutions for use in wind, solar, battery energy storage and EV infrastructure applications.
about:
American Wire Group (AWG) is headquartered in Aventura, Florida, with operation centers in Perris, California; Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania; and Katy, Texas. The company marks 25 years in business, having grown into a national supplier of wire, cable, hardware, and equipment for utility and renewable energy markets.

AWG manufactures and supplies a range of wire and cable products including aluminum, copper, steel, and fiber‑optic cables, as well as poles, pole‑line hardware, and accessories. Its value‑added services cover cable management and logistics, custom engineering and design, supply‑chain optimization, and emergency response. The company operates coast‑to‑coast warehouses and offers customization such as cut‑to‑length, paralleling, and custom labeling, along with reel disposal and specialty cable constructions.

The company serves utilities, renewable‑energy developers (wind, solar, battery energy storage), data‑center operators, EV and hydrogen‑fueling infrastructure projects, power transmission and distribution networks, substations, and industrial facilities. Government agencies and emergency‑response teams also rely on AWG for rapid material deployment during disaster recovery.

AWG emphasizes its extensive inventory and nationwide warehouse network as key differentiators, enabling delivery in days rather than weeks. Its ISO 9001:2015‑certified quality system and 24/7 emergency response capability are positioned as core reasons customers choose the company for mission‑critical projects.
